description: Sender-side L1 Quad per ADR-2605282200 — CACAO-signed by sender DID at the moment a kawase-yui send intent is materialized into an on-chain deposit. Carries the locked mid-market FX rate (with the fxRateAttestation CID for verification), the per-month cap consumption snapshot, and the optional encrypted memo CID per ADR-2605181100. The on-chain `Deposited` event on `KawaseYuiPool.sol` cross-references this AT Record by `intentCid` so any third party can replay the flow via MST traversal without a chain indexer.

srcStable.description: Source stablecoin symbol. R1 enum = USDC + EURC only; JPYC unlocks R2; KRWO/GBPe/CHFe unlock R3 with per-jurisdictionAttestation Council Lv7+ unanimity.

srcAmountMinor.description: Source amount in minor units (USDC/EURC 6-decimal; JPYC 18-decimal native). Sender MUST have approved the pool contract for this amount before deposit.

tgtAmountMinorQuoted.description: Target amount in target-stable minor units, computed from srcAmountMinor × fxRateBps at intent creation. This is the LOCKED amount the recipient will receive (reserve buffer absorbs any subsequent oracle drift).

fxRateBps.description: Locked FX rate in basis points (10000 = 1.0000). For USD→EUR at 0.92, fxRateBps = 9200.

fxRateAttestationCid.description: CID of the com.etzhayyim.kawase.fxRateAttestation record this rate was sourced from (kotoba content-addressed).

intentCid.description: kotoba content-addressed CID uniquely identifying this intent. Used as the keying field across deposit + matchExecution + claim chain.

perMonthCapRemainingMinor.description: Sender's remaining per-month cap (USD-equivalent minor units) AFTER this deposit. Per G9. R1 default cap = 1_000_000_000 (= $1000); R2 = $5000; R3 = $25000. Higher caps require Council Lv6+ ≥3 per-member ADR.

encryptedMemoCid.description: Optional. CID of an com.etzhayyim.encrypted.envelope record per ADR-2605181100 (XChaCha20-Poly1305, recipient-DID-bound). Defaults absent (no memo).
